routes.//: Security headers for every response. This config uses legacy `routes`, which cannot be combined with a top-level `headers` block — hence the `continue: true` pass-through entry. connect-src is the one to tighten: replace https: with your exact backend origin (the VITE_API_BASE_URL value) once it is stable.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com https://github.com; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https:; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
